Games/WizardsatPacers
Pacers 114Wizards 101

Siakam's 28 and a 14–0 run beat Washington

Final · Wed, Nov 11 · Indiana

Pascal Siakam scored 28, Ivica Zubac 20, and a 37–24 fourth quarter did it.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · TAP NEXT
1 · First half

How it started.

The Pacers led 26–25 after one quarter. At the half, the Pacers led 55–50.

2 · The difference

Siakam: 28 points, 12 of 12 at the line

8 rebounds, 5 assists, his ninth 20-point game of the season.

3 · How it turned

Tied 77–77 after three, then a 14–0 run to open the fourth

Siakam and Zubac combined for 48 of 114.

4 · Where it was won

Moved the ball and owned the paint

Assists 29–12; points in the paint 60–44. Indiana had 29 assists to Washington’s 12.

5 · Final

Pacers 114, Wizards 101.

From the Wizards’ side: Tied after three quarters, then lost the fourth 24–37.

What it meant: the Pacers are 4–8, 11th in the East, with 10% top-6 odds now. The Wizards are 4–9, 12th in the East, at 4%.

2 · The play of the game

Nembhard pulls up.

Andrew Nembhard's pull-up jumper with 9:04 left that capped Indiana's 14-0 run to open the fourth quarter and made it 91-77.
